title: Card number not in XREF is rejected with reason 100
condition: WHEN branch: the XREF read by DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM hits INVALID KEY. XREF holds only a different card, 4111111111111111.
expectation: The transaction goes to the reject file with fail reason 100 and description 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'. The account lookup is skipped. Nothing is posted: ACCOUNT stays at curr bal 500.00 and TCATBAL stays at 300.00. The reject count is 1 and the transaction count is 1.

title: Control: card found in XREF, transaction is posted
condition: Opposite branch: the XREF read succeeds. The fail reason stays 0, and the account exists, is not expired and is within its limit.
expectation: No reject record is written. The transaction is posted: account curr bal goes to 625.50, cyc credit goes to 325.50 and TCATBAL for 10000000001/01/0001 goes to 425.50. The reject count is 0.

title: Mixed batch: near-miss card rejected between two valid ones; reason resets per transaction
condition: Boundary and reset: the card differs from the XREF key only in its last digit. It sits between two valid transactions, which checks that the fail reason and description are reset to 0 and spaces before each transaction.
expectation: Only TRN0000000000004 is rejected, with reason 100 and 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'. TRN0000000000003 and TRN0000000000005 are both posted: account curr bal goes to 565.00 and TCATBAL goes to 365.00. The second valid transaction must not inherit reason 100. The transaction count is 3 and the reject count is 1.

title: Unknown card with an empty XREF file: reason 100 takes precedence over account failures
condition: XREF has no records. The amount is far over any credit limit and the only account in the file is expired. Because the account lookup is skipped, reasons 101, 102 and 103 can never apply.
expectation: The transaction is rejected with reason 100 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND', not 101, 102 or 103. ACCOUNT 10000000002 and TCATBAL stay the same. The reject count is 1.

title: Blank card number is treated as not found
condition: Edge case: DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM is all spaces, so the XREF read with a blank key hits INVALID KEY.
expectation: The transaction is rejected with reason 100 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'. Nothing is posted: ACCOUNT stays at 500.00 and TCATBAL at 300.00. The reject count is 1.

title: Card found in XREF but its account is missing from ACCOUNT
condition: Basic branch of the rule. The card cross-reference lookup succeeds (reason stays 0), but reading the account by XREF-ACCT-ID 90000000001 returns INVALID KEY. Apart from that the transaction is valid: amount 50.00 is far below any limit and the date is not expired.
expectation: The transaction is rejected with reason 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND' and a reject record is written. The reject count is 1 and the posted count is 0. No transaction is posted. The only ACCOUNT record (10000000001) and TCATBAL are not changed. The ACCOUNT-not-found warning from check_fixture is intended.
warnings: DALYTRAN[0] card's account 90000000001 not in ACCOUNT

title: Missing account wins over would-be over-limit and expiration failures
condition: Overrides the later checks. XREF-ACCT-ID 10000000002 sits between two existing accounts (10000000001 and 10000000003), so this is an adjacent-key boundary. Both neighbouring accounts have a credit limit of 100.00 and expired on 2020-01-01. The transaction amount is the maximum, 999999999.99, and ORIG-TS is 2099-12-31. If the program wrongly used the wrong account record or a stale one, the 102 and 103 checks would fail.
expectation: The reason is 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND', not 102 (over limit) and not 103 (expired), because the limit and expiration checks only run when the account is found. One reject is written and nothing is posted. Neither neighbouring account is changed.
warnings: DALYTRAN[0] card's account 10000000002 not in ACCOUNT

title: Missing-account reject between two valid postings
condition: A mixed batch that tests whether the program resets state between transactions. Transactions 1 and 3 use card ...0003, which points to existing account 20000000001 (posted). Transaction 2 uses card ...0004, which points to missing account 20000000002 (INVALID KEY).
expectation: Transactions 1 and 3 are posted. Account 20000000001 gets current balance 235.50 and cycle debit 235.50, and the TCATBAL record for 20000000001/01/0001 becomes 235.50. Transaction 2 is rejected with 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'. Totals are 2 posted and 1 rejected. The fail reason must go back to 0 for transaction 3, so it is not carried over from the reject.
warnings: DALYTRAN[1] card's account 20000000002 not in ACCOUNT

title: Precondition not met: card missing from XREF gives 100, not 101
condition: The Given condition fails. The card lookup returns INVALID KEY, so the fail reason is already non-zero and the account lookup must not run. Account 30000000001 exists but is linked to a different card.
expectation: The reason is 100 (card not found), not 101. One reject, nothing posted, and account 30000000001 is not changed. This shows that the 101 branch is only reached when the reason is still 0 after the XREF lookup.

title: Zero account ID in XREF and a negative (credit) amount
condition: Boundary key and negative amount. XREF-ACCT-ID is 00000000000, the lowest possible key. Account 00000000001 exists, but account 0 does not. A TCATBAL record does exist for account 0. The amount is -40.00, a refund that could never fail the limit check.
expectation: The account read for key 0 returns INVALID KEY. The transaction is rejected with 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND' even though the amount is negative. The TCATBAL record for account 0 stays at 10.00 and account 00000000001 is not changed. Totals are 1 reject and 0 posted.
warnings: DALYTRAN[0] card's account 0 not in ACCOUNT

title: Balance exactly equal to credit limit is accepted
condition: Boundary: limit equals the working balance, so 'limit < balance' is false. Credit 800.00 - debit 0 + amount 200.00 = 1000.00, and the limit is 1000.00.
expectation: The transaction passes the over-limit check (no reason 102). The expiration date is 2099-12-31, so it should be posted: the account's cycle credit and balance go up by 200.00, the TCATBAL record (1/01/0001) goes from 50.00 to 250.00, and no reject record is written.

title: One cent over the credit limit is rejected with reason 102
condition: Boundary +0.01: credit 800.00 - debit 0 + amount 200.01 = 1000.01, which is more than the 1000.00 limit.
expectation: Reason 102 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION' is set and the expiration check passes. The transaction is not posted, a reject record is written, and the reject count is 1. The ACCOUNT and TCATBAL records stay as they were.

title: Current balance above the limit is ignored; only cycle credit/debit count
condition: ACCT-CURR-BAL is 9500.00, well above the 1000.00 limit, but cycle credit 1200.00 - cycle debit 400.00 + amount 150.00 = 950.00, which is within the limit.
expectation: The transaction is accepted because the rule does not use ACCT-CURR-BAL. It is posted: the balance becomes 9650.00 and TCATBAL becomes 200.00. No reject is written. A port that wrongly checks the current balance would reject it.

title: High-order truncation of WS-TEMP-BAL hides a real over-limit
condition: Credit 1500000000.00 - debit 0 + amount 0.00 = 1,500,000,000.00. That needs 10 integer digits, but WS-TEMP-BAL holds only 9, so it is stored as 500,000,000.00 and compared with the 600,000,000.00 limit.
expectation: Because of the truncation, the stored balance (500,000,000.00) is within the limit, so no reason 102 is set and the transaction is posted with no reject. A port that uses unbounded arithmetic would compare the full 1.5 billion and reject it with 102. This case shows whether the port reproduces the truncation.

title: Negative transaction amount brings an already over-limit cycle back under
condition: Cycle credit 1250.00 is already above the 1000.00 limit. Adding the negative amount gives 1250.00 - 0 + (-300.00) = 950.00, which is within the limit.
expectation: There is no reason 102 because the negative amount is included in the working balance before the comparison. The transaction is posted: the balance becomes 900.00 and TCATBAL (5/02/0001) becomes -250.00. No reject is written.

title: Create new category balance record when none exists
condition: Create branch: the transaction is valid and TCATBAL has no record for key (10000000001, '01', 0001), so WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC is set to 'Y'
expectation: A new TCATBAL record is written with TRANCAT-ACCT-ID=10000000001, TRANCAT-TYPE-CD='01', TRANCAT-CD=0001 and TRAN-CAT-BAL=125.50 (zero plus the amount).

title: Update existing category balance with positive amount
condition: Update branch: a TCATBAL record exists for (10000000002, '01', 0001) with balance 1000.00, so the create flag stays 'N'
expectation: The existing record is rewritten with TRAN-CAT-BAL=1250.25 (1000.00 + 250.25). No duplicate record is created.

title: Update existing category balance with negative amount
condition: Update branch with a signed (negative) amount: the existing balance of 100.00 for (10000000003, '02', 0002) gets -40.00
expectation: The record is rewritten with TRAN-CAT-BAL=60.00. The sign is kept and the amount is subtracted.

title: Create with negative amount when only a different category exists for the account
condition: Create branch keyed on the full key: the account has a record for category 0001 but the transaction is category 0005, so the read by full key fails and the flag becomes 'Y'. The amount is negative.
expectation: A new record (10000000004, '01', 0005) is written with TRAN-CAT-BAL=-75.00. The existing record (10000000004, '01', 0001) stays at 500.00.

title: Update overflow: balance at maximum plus one cent truncates
condition: Update branch at the 9-integer-digit limit: the existing balance is 999999999.99 and 0.01 is added. The ADD has no ON SIZE ERROR.
expectation: The sum 1000000000.00 loses its high-order digit and the record is rewritten with TRAN-CAT-BAL=0.00. No error is raised.

title: Same key twice in one run: create then update
condition: Both branches in sequence: the first transaction for (10000000006, '03', 0007) finds no record and creates one. The second transaction finds the newly written record and updates it.
expectation: There is exactly one TCATBAL record for (10000000006, '03', 0007), with TRAN-CAT-BAL=30.00 (10.00 from the create plus 20.00 from the update).

title: Positive amount goes to current balance and cycle credit
condition: DALYTRAN-AMT is positive (125.50), so the 'zero or more' branch runs. Account, cross-reference and category balance records all match, and the transaction passes validation (well under the credit limit, expiry date in the future).
expectation: Account 1 is rewritten with ACCT-CURR-BAL 1000.00 -> 1125.50 and ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT 200.00 -> 325.50. ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT stays at -50.00. One transaction record TRN0000000000001 is written with every DALYTRAN field copied unchanged (amount 125.50, merchant FRESH MART / SPRINGFIELD / 62701, card 4000000000000001, original timestamp 2024-03-15-10.30.00.000000). TRAN-PROC-TS has the form YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.ff0000. No reject record is written and the reject count is 0.

title: Negative amount goes to current balance and cycle debit
condition: DALYTRAN-AMT is negative (-75.25), so the negative branch runs and the amount is added, with its sign, to the cycle debit total.
expectation: Account 2 is rewritten with ACCT-CURR-BAL 500.00 -> 424.75 and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT -100.00 -> -175.25, so the debit total goes down. ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT stays at 400.00. Transaction TRN0000000000002 is written with TRAN-AMT -75.25 and all other fields copied, plus a generated TRAN-PROC-TS. No reject is recorded.

title: Sign boundary: zero amount and minus one cent
condition: Tests the boundary between the two branches. DALYTRAN-AMT 0.00 (on account 3) must take the 'zero or more' branch. DALYTRAN-AMT -0.01 (on account 4) is the smallest negative value and must take the debit branch.
expectation: Account 3: ACCT-CURR-BAL stays 250.00 and the cycle credit branch runs, so ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT stays 10.00 and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT stays -5.00. The record is still rewritten. Account 4: ACCT-CURR-BAL 0.00 -> -0.01, ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT 0.00 -> -0.01, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT stays 0.00. Both transactions are written: TRN0000000000003 with amount 0.00 and TRN0000000000004 with amount -0.01. The reject count is 0.

title: Several transactions on one account build up the totals
condition: Three transactions on the same account (+500.00, -200.00, +0.01), starting from a negative current balance. The third uses a type/category with no existing TCATBAL record, so a new category balance is created first, and the account update still follows.
expectation: Each posting re-reads and rewrites account 5. The final values are: ACCT-CURR-BAL -150.75 + 500.00 - 200.00 + 0.01 = 149.26; ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT 1000.00 + 500.00 + 0.01 = 1500.01; ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT -300.00 - 200.00 = -500.00. Three transaction records are written, TRN0000000000005, TRN0000000000006 and TRN0000000000007, each a copy of its daily record with a processing timestamp. The reason code is reset between records, there are no rejects, and the reject count is 0.

title: Every field is copied at its full width and large amounts add correctly
condition: Every DALYTRAN field is filled to or near its maximum width: a 100-character description, a 10-character source, ZIP 94105-1234, merchant ID 999999999, category 9999 and amount 99999999.99. This checks that the copy into the transaction record keeps every field intact and that large amounts add correctly in S9(10)V99.
expectation: Account 6 is rewritten with ACCT-CURR-BAL 1234567.89 + 99999999.99 = 101234567.88 and ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT 0.01 -> 100000000.00. ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT stays -0.01. Transaction ZZTRANFULLCOPY99 is written with every field matching the daily record exactly: description, merchant name/city/ZIP, merchant ID 999999999, category 9999, amount 99999999.99, original timestamp 2024-12-31-23.59.59.999999. TRAN-PROC-TS is the current system timestamp, ending in '0000' and using '-' and '.' separators. There are no rejects.

values.value: Annual membership renewal - premium tier, includes lounge access and travel insurance coverage 2024

title: Account change between two single-category accounts
condition: The first record has WS-FIRST-TIME='Y', so no update runs. The second record has a different TRANCAT-ACCT-ID with WS-FIRST-TIME='N', so the previous account (10000000001) is updated.
expectation: Account 10000000001: ACCT-CURR-BAL goes from 500.00 to 512.00 (1200.00*12.00/1200 = 12.00), and ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT become 0. All other fields stay the same. Account 10000000002 (2400.00*12/1200 = 24.00) is the last group, so it is only updated if the program also updates at end of file. If it does, its balance becomes 1024.00 and its cycle fields become 0.

title: Two categories for the same account, then an account change
condition: Two records in a row share an account ID, so no update runs between them and the interest adds up in WS-TOTAL-INT. The account change on the third record triggers one update with the combined total.
expectation: Account 10000000011: total interest = 12.00 (1200*12/1200) + 12.00 (600*24/1200) = 24.00. ACCT-CURR-BAL goes from 1000.00 to 1024.00 and the cycle credit and debit become 0. It is rewritten once only, not after each category. Account 10000000012 earns 1.00 interest; if it is updated at end of file, its balance becomes 51.00.

title: Zero-rate account is still rewritten with its cycle fields cleared
condition: The previous account's only category has DIS-INT-RATE = 0, so WS-TOTAL-INT is 0. The account change still triggers the update.
expectation: Account 10000000021: ACCT-CURR-BAL stays at 300.00 (300.00 + 0), but ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT (250.00) and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT (75.00) both become 0 and the record is rewritten. Account 10000000022 earns 12.00 interest; if it is updated at end of file, its balance becomes 712.00.

title: Negative balances and dropped fractions in the total
condition: The previous account has a negative balance and a negative category balance, plus a second category whose interest has a fraction smaller than one cent. This tests the signed add with no rounding and the signed cycle fields.
expectation: Account 10000000031: category 01 gives -1000.00*15/1200 = -12.50. Category 02 gives 100.00*10/1200 = 0.8333, which is cut to 0.83, not rounded. Total = -11.67. ACCT-CURR-BAL goes from -200.00 to -211.67. The cycle credit (1234.56) and the negative cycle debit (-65.43) both become 0. Account 10000000032 earns 5.00; if it is updated at end of file, its balance becomes 5.00.

title: Three accounts: the total resets between groups, with a balance near the 10-digit limit
condition: There are two account changes. WS-TOTAL-INT must reset to 0 at each change, so each account gets only its own interest. The first account's balance is close to the S9(10)V99 maximum but does not overflow.
expectation: Account 10000000041: ACCT-CURR-BAL goes from 9999999900.00 to 9999999912.00 (+12.00). Account 10000000042: 100.00 + 36.00 = 136.00, not 148.00, which would mean the total was not reset. Both have their cycle credit and debit set to 0. Account 10000000043 earns 6.00; if it is updated at end of file, its balance becomes 206.00. ACCOUNT-RECORD is rewritten under the previous account's own ID each time, not the new account's.

title: Single account, single category: transaction written, account left unchanged
condition: There is only one account group in TCATBAL. That group is the last one, so end of file ends the loop and 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT is never performed for it.
expectation: One interest transaction is written for card 4000000000000001 for 18.00 (1200.00 * 18.00 / 1200). Account 10000000001 is not rewritten: ACCT-CURR-BAL stays 500.00 (not 518.00), ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT stays 100.00 and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT stays 250.00.

title: Two accounts: first updated on account change, last not updated
condition: When the account ID changes, the update for the earlier account runs. At end of file the update for the last account never runs.
expectation: Two interest transactions are written: 18.00 for 10000000001 and 12.00 for 10000000002 (600.00 * 24 / 1200). Account 10000000001 is rewritten with ACCT-CURR-BAL 518.00 and cycle credit and debit set to 0. Account 10000000002 is unchanged: balance 800.00, cycle credit 40.00, cycle debit 75.50.

title: Last account with two categories: both transactions written, total interest lost
condition: WS-TOTAL-INT builds up across several category records of the last account group, then end of file stops the loop before the account update.
expectation: Two interest transactions are written for card 4000000000000003: 18.00 (1200.00 at 18%) and 3.00 (300.00 at 12%). The total of 21.00 is never applied. Account 10000000003 stays at balance 1500.00, cycle credit 300.00 and cycle debit 1500.00.

title: Empty category balance file: no account updated
condition: The first read returns status '10', so END-OF-FILE becomes 'Y' on the first pass and the loop ends.
expectation: No interest transactions are written. Account 10000000004 is not rewritten: balance stays 250.00, cycle credit 20.00, cycle debit 60.00.

title: First account at zero rate is still updated; last account at non-zero rate is not
condition: Contrast case. The update on account change runs even when the total interest is zero. Writing transactions depends only on DIS-INT-RATE not being zero, while the last account's update depends on the end-of-file branch, which never runs.
expectation: Only one interest transaction is written: 36.00 for card 4000000000000006 (2400.00 * 18 / 1200). No transaction is written for 10000000005 because its rate is 0. Account 10000000005 is rewritten: balance 900.00 (plus 0 interest), cycle credit and debit set to 0. Account 10000000006 is unchanged: balance 2400.00, cycle credit 10.00, cycle debit 90.00.

title: Exact group/type/category match is used even though a DEFAULT record also exists
condition: First read with key GOLD/01/0001 returns status 00, so the DEFAULT fallback is never tried. The rate is not zero (18.00).
expectation: The rate is 18.00 from the GOLD record, not 24.00 from DEFAULT. Monthly interest on 1200.00 = 1200.00*18.00/1200 = 18.00, and that interest is written for account 1. Fees are computed because the rate is not zero.

title: No exact match: fall back to DEFAULT with the same type and category
condition: SILVER/01/0001 does not exist (status 23). SILVER has a record only for category 0002. The program retries with DEFAULT/01/0001. A DEFAULT/02/0001 record also exists, to show that the type code is kept.
expectation: The rate is 15.00 from DEFAULT/01/0001. It is not 12.00 (the SILVER record for another category) or 30.00 (DEFAULT for another type). Interest = 1000.00*15.00/1200 = 12.50. The program does not abend.

title: Exact match with zero rate skips interest and does not fall back
condition: GOLD/01/0001 exists with DIS-INT-RATE 0.00 (status 00). Only a missing record (status 23) triggers the fallback, so the non-zero DEFAULT rate of 24.00 must not be used.
expectation: The rate is 0.00, so no interest transaction and no fee are produced for this balance. The account's interest total stays 0, and ACCT-CURR-BAL is unchanged by interest. The program ends normally.

title: Fallback to DEFAULT: zero rate for one category, non-zero for another on the same account
condition: The account group PLATINUM has no disclosure records, so both balances fall back to DEFAULT. DEFAULT/01/0001 has rate 0.00, which skips that balance. DEFAULT/01/0002 has rate 6.00, which computes interest.
expectation: Category 0001 (600.00) gets no interest and no fee. Category 0002 (2400.00) gets interest 2400.00*6.00/1200 = 12.00. The total interest for account 4 is 12.00. The program does not abend.

title: Neither the group nor the DEFAULT record exists for the type and category: abend
condition: BRONZE/01/0003 is missing (status 23), so the program retries with DEFAULT/01/0003, which is also missing. Close records exist (BRONZE/02/0003 and DEFAULT/01/0001) but none matches the full key.
expectation: The DEFAULT read does not return status 00, so the program displays 'ERROR READING DEFAULT DISCLOSURE GROUP' and abends. No interest is computed from the near-miss records.
